answer: Price doubles per sibling. Each vertex, one claimed agent, must register on the ledge, a public registry that traces every deposit back through its funding graph, so clones paid from one source collide in one lineage. The k-th vertex in a lineage burns 2^(k-1) copper, a scarce token destroyed on entry, while a lone honest agent burns one. Ten clones cost 1,023 copper; thirty cost over a billion. It breaks if attackers can cheaply obtain unlinked copper through mixers or fresh exchange accounts.
